subject.title: fix(tts): allow trusted local media in message_tool_only mode

question: Should `trustedLocalMedia` be accepted as sufficient provenance to bypass `message_tool_only` suppression when the dispatcher strips all outbound text?
rationale: This is a deliberate policy decision at the boundary between private source-reply suppression and channel delivery; tests can show the implementation but cannot choose the permanent trust contract.

options.title: Accept the bounded trusted-media contract
options.body: Approve the current media-only bypass after exact-head live proof confirms the adapter receives a voice payload with no outbound text.

options.title: Require stronger provenance
options.body: Keep the PR open and require an additional runtime-owned provenance marker or owner-specific validation before any suppressed delivery bypass is allowed.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded trusted-media contract
recommendation.body: Approve the current media-only bypass after exact-head live proof confirms the adapter receives a voice payload with no outbound text.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows this person was explicitly brought into the review discussion, and the remaining question is product/security policy rather than a test-only repair.
